AWSSecretsDef.description: Global AWS Secrets Manager client defaults.

region.description: Default AWS region for Secrets Manager lookups.

AlibabaSecretsDef.description: Global Alibaba Cloud KMS client defaults.

ca_file.description: CA certificate file for an Alibaba Cloud KMS dedicated gateway.

endpoint.description: Optional Alibaba Cloud KMS shared or dedicated gateway endpoint.

region.description: Default Alibaba Cloud region for KMS secret lookups.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain audit logs. Default: 7.

mode.description: Authentication mode. Defaults to 'builtin'. OIDC is now configured under builtin mode (auth.oidc).

AuthOIDCDef.description: OIDC authentication configuration for use with builtin auth mode.

allowed_domains.description: Allowed email domains for OIDC login.

auto_signup.description: Automatically create user accounts on first OIDC login. Default: true (builtin mode only).

button_label.description: Label for the OIDC login button.

AuthProxyDef.description: Authentication delegated to an authenticating reverse proxy.

AzureSecretsDef.description: Global Azure Key Vault client defaults.

CoordinatorDef.description: Coordinator service configuration for distributed execution.

advertise.description: Advertised address for workers to connect to. Auto-detected if empty.

enabled.description: Enable the coordinator service for distributed execution. Default: true.

health_port.description: Coordinator HTTP health check port. Default: 8091. Set to 0 to disable.

symlinks.description: Include file symlinks in recursive DAG discovery and allow file symlinks whose targets are outside the configured DAG directory.

enabled.description: Enable the centralized event store. Default: true.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain event logs. Default: 1.

GCPSecretsDef.description: Global GCP Secret Manager client defaults.

location.description: Default location for regional Secret Manager lookups.

project_id.description: Default GCP project ID for Secret Manager lookups.

ssh_key_path.description: Path to SSH private key file.

on_startup.description: Sync on application startup. Default: true.

GitSyncDef.description: Git synchronization configuration for DAG definitions.

path.description: Subdirectory within the repository. Empty for root.

push_enabled.description: Enable pushing changes back to the repository. Default: true.

allowed_ips.description: IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and CIDR ranges allowed to access the HTTP server. Empty disables filtering.

trusted_proxies.description: Proxy addresses and CIDR ranges permitted to supply forwarded client IP headers.

context.description: Default kubeconfig context for secret lookups.

kubeconfig.description: Default kubeconfig path for secret lookups.

namespace.description: Default Kubernetes namespace for secret lookups.

OIDCRoleMappingDef.description: Maps OIDC claims to Dagu roles.

default_role.description: Default role assigned to users. Default: 'viewer'.

default_workspace_access.description: Workspace access assigned when no global or workspace mapping matches. Required with non-empty workspace_mappings; otherwise defaults to 'all'.

group_mappings.description: Mapping of IdP group names to Dagu role names.

groups_claim.description: OIDC claim containing group information. Default: 'groups'.

role_attribute_path.description: jq expression for extracting role from OIDC claims.

role_attribute_strict.description: Deny login when neither a global nor workspace mapping matches.

skip_org_role_sync.description: Keep first-login role and workspace access assignments instead of synchronizing subsequent logins.

workspace_mappings.description: Mapping of IdP group names to workspace role grants.

OIDCWorkspaceGrantDef.description: Assigns an OIDC group member a role in one workspace.

env_passthrough.description: Exact environment variable names forwarded to the managed OpenCode service.

executable.description: OpenCode executable path or command name.

artifact_dir.description: Directory for DAG run artifact files.

base_config.description: Path to the base configuration file.

dag_run_work_dir.description: Directory for DAG run working directories. Defaults to {paths.data_dir}/dag-run-work.

dag_runs_dir.description: Directory for DAG run history storage.

dag_state_dir.description: Directory for persistent DAG state files.

event_store_dir.description: Directory for centralized event log files and inbox files.

remote_nodes_dir.description: Directory for remote node data storage.

suspend_flags_dir.description: Directory for DAG suspend flag files.

tools_dir.description: Directory for managed DAG tool cache, locks, manifests, and shims.

PeerDef.description: TLS configuration for peer gRPC connections.

cert_file.description: Path to the peer TLS certificate file.

client_ca_file.description: Path to the client CA certificate file.

insecure.description: Use h2c (HTTP/2 cleartext) instead of TLS.

key_file.description: Path to the peer TLS private key file.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of connection retries. Default: 10.

write_dags.description: Allow creating and editing DAG definitions.

conn_max_idle_time.description: Maximum idle time in seconds. Default: 60.

conn_max_lifetime.description: Maximum connection lifetime in seconds. Default: 300.

max_idle_conns.description: Maximum number of idle connections. Default: 5.

max_open_conns.description: Maximum number of open connections. Default: 25.

ProcDef.description: Local proc-file heartbeat configuration shared by all local execution commands.

heartbeat_interval.description: Heartbeat write interval for process liveness. Default: '5s'.

heartbeat_sync_interval.description: Deprecated and ignored. Accepted so existing configuration files remain valid.

stale_threshold.description: Duration after which a process heartbeat is considered stale. Default: '90s'.

ProxyHeadersDef.description: Identity headers populated by the authenticating proxy.

ProxyRoleMappingDef.description: Maps proxy groups to Dagu authorization.

require_mapping.description: Deny login unless at least one group or workspace mapping matches.

skip_org_role_sync.description: Preserve existing role and workspace access instead of synchronizing subsequent logins.

ProxyWorkspaceGrantDef.description: Assigns a proxy group member a role in one workspace.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent runs for this queue.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the remote node's API.

auth_token.description: Auth token for this remote node.

auth_type.description: Authentication type for this remote node.

basic_auth_password.description: Basic auth password for this remote node.

basic_auth_username.description: Basic auth username for this remote node.

description.description: Optional description for the remote node.

name.description: Display name for the remote node.

skip_tls_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for this remote node.

max_topics_per_connection.description: Maximum topics a single client connection may subscribe to. Default: 20.

slow_client_timeout.description: Timeout before disconnecting a slow client. Default: '30s'.

write_buffer_size.description: Per-client write buffer size in bytes. Default: 65536.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive stale checks before declaring a zombie. Default: 3.

heartbeat_interval.description: Deprecated: use proc.heartbeat_interval. Heartbeat write interval for process liveness. Default: '5s'.

heartbeat_sync_interval.description: Deprecated and ignored. Accepted so existing configuration files remain valid.

lock_retry_interval.description: Interval between lock retry attempts. Default: '5s'.

lock_stale_threshold.description: Duration after which a lock is considered stale. Default: '30s'.

stale_threshold.description: Deprecated: use proc.stale_threshold. Duration after which a process heartbeat is considered stale. Default: '90s'.

zombie_detection_interval.description: Interval for detecting zombie processes. Default: '45s'. Set to '0' to disable.

SecretsDef.description: Shared defaults for external secret providers.

ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate file for client verification.

cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file.

key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

funnel.description: Enable Tailscale Funnel for public internet access.

enabled.description: Enable the web-based terminal. Default: false.

ttl.description: Token time-to-live duration up to 8760h (365 days), e.g. '24h'.

TunnelDef.description: Tunnel service configuration for remote access.

allow_terminal.description: Allow terminal access through tunnel. Default: false.

allowed_ips.description: IP addresses allowed through the tunnel. Empty allows all.

TunnelRateLimitDef.description: Rate limiting for tunnel authentication endpoints.

block_duration_seconds.description: Duration to block after exceeding limit in seconds. Default: 900.

login_attempts.description: Maximum login attempts within the window. Default: 5.

window_seconds.description: Rate limit window duration in seconds. Default: 300.

max_dashboard_page_limit.description: Maximum number of items per dashboard page.

navbar_color.description: Navigation bar background color (CSS color value).

ca_cert.description: CA certificate file for verifying a custom Vault TLS endpoint.

client_cert.description: Client certificate file for Vault mutual TLS authentication.

client_key.description: Client private key file for Vault mutual TLS authentication.

max_payload_size.description: Maximum accepted webhook request payload size in bytes. Default: 1048576.

WorkerDef.description: Worker process configuration for distributed execution.

coordinators.description: Coordinator address(es) for the worker command. Required when running `dagu worker`. Accepts a single string or an array.

health_port.description: Worker HTTP health check port. Default: 8092. Set to 0 to disable.

labels.description: Worker labels for selective execution. Accepts a comma-separated string or an object.

max_active_runs.description: Maximum concurrent DAG runs for this worker.

description: Schema for Dagu configuration file (config.yaml). Configures server settings, authentication, paths, UI, services, and features.

access_log_mode.description: HTTP access log mode. 'all' logs every request, 'non-public' skips public endpoints (/health, /auth/login, /auth/setup), 'none' disables access logging entirely. Default: 'none'.

api_base_path.description: Base path for the API endpoints.

artifact_dir.description: Directory for DAG run artifact files.

base_config.description: Path to the base configuration file.

base_path.description: Base path for the web UI (e.g., '/dagu').

check_updates.description: Enable automatic update checks for web UI notifications. Manual 'dagu upgrade' checks are unaffected.

cors_allowed_origins.description: Origins allowed to make cross-origin requests. When unset or empty, cross-origin browser access is disabled. Exact origins enable credentials. An explicit '*' allows every origin without credentials and emits a security warning.

dags.description: Deprecated: use dags_dir or paths.dags_dir instead.

debug.description: Enable debug mode with verbose logging.

default_execution_mode.description: Default execution mode for DAGs. 'local' runs DAGs on the server process, 'distributed' dispatches to workers.

env_passthrough.description: Additional exact environment variable names to forward from the Dagu process environment to step execution.

env_passthrough_prefixes.description: Additional environment variable prefixes to forward from the Dagu process environment to step execution.

event_store_dir.description: Directory for centralized event log files and inbox files.

headless.description: Run in headless mode without the web UI.

latest_status_today.description: Deprecated. Show only today's latest status on the dashboard.

log_encoding_charset.description: Deprecated: use ui.log_encoding_charset instead. Character encoding for log display.

max_dashboard_page_limit.description: Deprecated: use ui.max_dashboard_page_limit instead. Maximum items per dashboard page.

navbar_color.description: Deprecated: use ui.navbar_color instead. Navigation bar color.

navbar_title.description: Deprecated: use ui.navbar_title instead. Navigation bar title.

permission_run_dags.description: Deprecated: use permissions.run_dags instead. Allow running DAGs.

permission_write_dags.description: Deprecated: use permissions.write_dags instead. Allow writing DAG definitions.

public_url.description: Public base URL used when generating links back to the Dagu web UI (e.g., 'https://dagu.example.com').

remote_nodes.description: List of remote node connections for distributed monitoring.

suspend_flags_dir.description: Directory for DAG suspend flag files.
